mentions.snippet: Good alternatives to Asanna (Asana, Inc.'s work-management app), depending on what pushes you away from it:
1. clickup: the most features per dollar, though the interface overwhelms new users.
2. Trello (owned by Atlassian): fine for simple kanban, but you'll outgrow it once you need dependencies.
